title: Seeking to Self-Worth
subtitle: A cross-linked bridge between two recurring pressures
description: Guru answers seeking by showing where wandering ends and dwelling begins. This bridge then carries into guru restores worth by placing identity inside grace, humility, and belonging to the one.
